ctx.x: Operation Entertainment was a show put together by Chuck Barris. Now, you know who Chuck Barris is. He's the Dating Game, the Mating Game, everything this man touched turned to gold. Everyone but the one Operation Entertainment, naturally. We did it for two seasons any way.
